description: This file contains setup functions for initializing default settings, creating price lists, employee records, territories, and fiscal year details in an ERP system using the Frappe framework.

methods.name: set_default_settings
methods.description: Initializes default system settings including currency, fiscal year, company info, domain, stock, sales, purchasing, delivery, and HR settings.

methods.name: set_no_copy_fields_in_variant_settings
methods.description: Sets default fields for item variant settings.

methods.name: create_price_lists
methods.description: Creates default selling and buying price lists based on provided arguments.

methods.name: create_employee_for_self
methods.description: Creates an employee record for the current user if not administrator.

methods.name: create_territories
methods.description: Creates default territories for the country and 'Rest of the World'.

methods.name: create_feed_and_todo
methods.description: Placeholder for updating activity feed and creating todos.

methods.name: get_fy_details
methods.description: Generates fiscal year string based on start and end dates.
